title: Modern Warfare 4 duyuruldu: Yeni Counter-Strike modu geliyor
summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Counter-Strike benzeri ekonomi sistemine sahip yeni çok oyunculu modu Collateral'ı duyurdu.
body:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Counter-Strike benzeri ekonomi sistemine sahip yeni **Collateral** modunu duyurdu. Activision'ın açıklamasına göre yeni mod, oyunun bilinen Search and Destroy formülüne maç içinde kazanılan parayla ekipman alma mekaniğini ekliyor.

## Collateral modu nasıl çalışacak?

Modun temelini Search and Destroy yapısı oluşturuyor. Oyuncular her tura tabancayla başlıyor; rakipleri alt ederek ve hedefleri tamamlayarak para kazanıyorlar. Kazanılan bu paralar turlar arasında zırh, perk, ekipman ve daha güçlü silahlara harcanıyor. Oyuncular isterlerse takımlarını bir araya getirerek ortak para havuzuyla UAV alabiliyor.

## Öne çıkan özellikler ve çıkış tarihi

Yeni mod, Call of Duty'nin normalde sahip olduğu yeniden doğma, Killstreak, otomatik can yenileme ve özel silah dizilimleri gibi sistemleri ortadan kaldırıyor. Ölen oyuncular satın aldıkları ekipmanları kaybediyor ancak biriken paraları sonraki tura aktarılıyor. Activision'ın duyurusuna göre oyun **23 Ekim** tarihinde oyuncularla buluşacak.

**Neden önemli?** Modern Warfare 4, PC oyuncuları için 800'den fazla özelleştirme seçeneği, yerleşik performans testi, DLSS 4.5 ve AMD FSR Redstone desteği gibi teknik iyileştirmeler de sunuyor.

source_texts.title: Modern Warfare 4's New 'Counter-Strike' Mode Officially Announced
source_texts.summary: Modern Warfare 4's new Collateral mode borrows Counter-Strike's cash economy, letting players earn and spend money between rounds.
source_texts.text:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is taking a page from Counter-Strike with a new multiplayer mode built around one of the classic shooter's defining mechanics: buying your gear with money earned during the match. Called Collateral, the new mode puts an economy system on top of the familiar Search and Destroy formula, creating a version of Call of Duty where every death and purchase could have consequences.
Activision revealed Collateral in a new blog post primarily focused on Modern Warfare 4's PC features, with the mode getting only a brief introduction for now. The game is also getting a pile of PC-specific technical improvements, including more than 800 customization options, a built-in performance benchmark, and support for technologies including DLSS 4.5 and AMD FSR Redstone.
But Collateral is arguably the more interesting addition, especially for anyone familiar with Counter-Strike or other competitive shooters built around an in-game economy.
How Collateral works
At its core, Collateral is a riff on Call of Duty's Search and Destroy mode. Teams alternate between attacking and defending two bomb sites, but instead of heading into every round with a predetermined loadout, everyone starts with a pistol and has to earn money to upgrade their equipment.
Players earn cash by eliminating enemies and playing the objective, then spend it between rounds on armor, perks, equipment and increasingly powerful weapons. The available options include grenades, a Riot Shield, multiple pistols, shotguns, LMGs, SMGs, rifles and sniper rifles. Teams can also pool their money for a UAV.
The mode also strips away several of the systems that normally define Call of Duty. There are no respawns, Killstreaks, automatic health regeneration or custom loadouts. If you die, you lose the gear you bought, although your accumulated cash carries over into the next round. That combination should make Collateral feel considerably different from standard Search and Destroy, while giving Modern Warfare 4 a familiar competitive structure with a very Counter-Strike-style layer of economic decision-making on top.
Activision hasn't revealed much more yet, promising additional details on Collateral closer to launch. Modern Warfare 4 arrives Oct. 23.
